    | text      = I was looking forward to Hades 2 and Final Fantasy Tactics.
}}

{{TranscriptBlock
    | name      = Unknown Speaker
    | timestamp = 00:05:36.800
    | text      = And I was playing Hades 2 for a while but then I got back into Tactics and man, it's
}}

{{TranscriptBlock
    | name      = Unknown Speaker
    | timestamp = 00:05:41.800
    | text      = just one of the, it's just so great.
}}

{{TranscriptBlock
    | name      = Unknown Speaker
    | timestamp = 00:05:43.800
    | text      = Yeah.
}}

{{TranscriptBlock
    | name      = Unknown Speaker
    | timestamp = 00:05:44.300
    | text      = It's so great and I was thinking about what makes it so great from a storytelling perspective.
}}

{{TranscriptBlock
    | name      = Unknown Speaker
    | timestamp = 00:05:48.800
    | text      = And it does have one of my favorite things to do.
}}

{{TranscriptBlock
    | name      = Unknown Speaker
    | timestamp = 00:05:51.300
    | text      = Uh, which is, the story is not the story.
}}

{{TranscriptBlock
    | name      = Unknown Speaker
    | timestamp = 00:05:55.300
    | text      = Right?
}}

{{TranscriptBlock
    | name      = Unknown Speaker
    | timestamp = 00:05:56.300
    | text      = You're playing somebody else's side character.
}}

{{TranscriptBlock
    | name      = Unknown Speaker
    | timestamp = 00:06:00.300
    | text      = You've got your own whole thing going on, right?
}}

{{TranscriptBlock
    | name      = Unknown Speaker
    | timestamp = 00:06:03.300
    | text      = But beside you is the actual King Arthur.
}}

{{TranscriptBlock
    | name      = Unknown Speaker
    | timestamp = 00:06:07.300
    | text      = The guy who's going to become the king.
}}

{{TranscriptBlock
    | name      = Unknown Speaker
    | timestamp = 00:06:09.300
    | text      = Who's going on that whole hero's journey to defeat this guy and yada yada yada.
}}

{{TranscriptBlock
    | name      = Unknown Speaker
    | timestamp = 00:06:13.800
    | text      = And you're over here and your story intersects with that one.
}}

{{TranscriptBlock
    | name      = Unknown Speaker
    | timestamp = 00:06:18.300
    | text      = Like, it comes in and out.
}}

{{TranscriptBlock
    | name      = Unknown Speaker
    | timestamp = 00:06:19.800
    | text      = You know?
}}

{{TranscriptBlock
    | name      = Unknown Speaker
    | timestamp = 00:06:20.300
    | text      = It's always around you.
}}

{{TranscriptBlock
    | name      = Unknown Speaker
    | timestamp = 00:06:22.300
    | text      = But you're on this different quest entirely.
}}

{{TranscriptBlock
    | name      = Unknown Speaker
    | timestamp = 00:06:24.800
    | text      = Feels kind of like Skyrim.
}}

{{TranscriptBlock
    | name      = Unknown Speaker
    | timestamp = 00:06:26.300
    | text      = The way that the world is existing in this civil war kind of thing.
}}

{{TranscriptBlock
    | name      = Unknown Speaker
    | timestamp = 00:06:30.300
    | text      = But then also you're...
}}

{{TranscriptBlock
    | name      = Unknown Speaker
    | timestamp = 00:06:31.800
    | text      = And then you're doing your old dragon thing.
}}

{{TranscriptBlock
    | name      = Unknown Speaker
    | timestamp = 00:06:33.300
    | text      = Yeah, yeah, yeah.
}}

{{TranscriptBlock
    | name      = Unknown Speaker
    | timestamp = 00:06:34.300
    | text      = It's whenever you've got a straightforward plot.
}}

{{TranscriptBlock
    | name      = Unknown Speaker
    | timestamp = 00:06:37.300
    | text      = Where you start from one point and you end at another.
}}

{{TranscriptBlock
    | name      = Unknown Speaker
    | timestamp = 00:06:40.300
    | text      = Right?
}}

{{TranscriptBlock
    | name      = Unknown Speaker
    | timestamp = 00:06:41.300
    | text      = One of the great ways to make it feel like there's a lot of twists and turns is if you're setting is the plot of another book.
}}

{{TranscriptBlock
    | name      = Unknown Speaker
    | timestamp = 00:06:47.300
    | text      = Sure.
}}

{{TranscriptBlock
    | name      = Unknown Speaker
    | timestamp = 00:06:47.800
    | text      = Right?
}}

{{TranscriptBlock
    | name      = Unknown Speaker
    | timestamp = 00:06:48.300
    | text      = So it's like, well, I'm going from room to room in this house basically.
}}

{{TranscriptBlock
    | name      = Unknown Speaker
    | timestamp = 00:06:52.800
    | text      = Each room is like a new encounter.
}}

{{TranscriptBlock
    | name      = Unknown Speaker
    | timestamp = 00:06:54.800
    | text      = Right?
}}

{{TranscriptBlock
    | name      = Unknown Speaker
    | timestamp = 00:06:55.300
    | text      = But the way it makes me feel like I'm twisting and turning on the ocean is because that other guy is just running by me going like,
}}

{{TranscriptBlock
    | name      = Unknown Speaker
    | timestamp = 00:07:02.300
    | text      = AHHH!
}}

{{TranscriptBlock
    | name      = Unknown Speaker
    | timestamp = 00:07:03.300
    | text      = And then he's gone.
}}

{{TranscriptBlock
    | name      = Unknown Speaker
    | timestamp = 00:07:03.800
    | text      = Yeah.
}}

{{TranscriptBlock
    | name      = Unknown Speaker
    | timestamp = 00:07:04.300
    | text      = That's great.
}}

{{TranscriptBlock
    | name      = Unknown Speaker
    | timestamp = 00:07:04.800
    | text      = I know I told you I would play it and I've yet to do that.
}}

{{TranscriptBlock
    | name      = Unknown Speaker
    | timestamp = 00:07:08.800
    | text      = But one of these days I will.
}}

{{TranscriptBlock
    | name      = Unknown Speaker
    | timestamp = 00:07:10.300
    | text      = Thanks.
}}

{{TranscriptBlock
    | name      = Unknown Speaker
    | timestamp = 00:07:10.800
    | text      = Based on everything you've said and everybody else has said, I can't imagine how I would be disappointed.
}}

{{TranscriptBlock
    | name      = Unknown Speaker
    | timestamp = 00:07:17.300
    | text      = I don't.
}}

{{TranscriptBlock
    | name      = Unknown Speaker
    | timestamp = 00:07:17.800
    | text      = I just don't know how to build it up more because if you don't like it, fine, whatever, you're wrong.
}}

{{TranscriptBlock
    | name      = Unknown Speaker
    | timestamp = 00:07:24.800
    | text      = That's how great it is.
}}

{{TranscriptBlock
    | name      = Unknown Speaker
    | timestamp = 00:07:25.800
    | text      = That's fair.
}}

{{TranscriptBlock
    | name      = Unknown Speaker
    | timestamp = 00:07:26.800
    | text      = That's fair.
}}

{{TranscriptBlock
    | name      = Unknown Speaker
    | timestamp = 00:07:27.300
    | text      = I have that feeling about some things.
}}

{{TranscriptBlock
    | name      = Unknown Speaker
    | timestamp = 00:07:28.800
    | text      = I will hear no negative talk about it.
}}

{{TranscriptBlock
    | name      = Unknown Speaker
    | timestamp = 00:07:31.800
    | text      = Yep.
}}

{{TranscriptBlock
    | name      = Unknown Speaker
    | timestamp = 00:07:32.800
    | text      = And I respect that other people have their things.
}}

{{TranscriptBlock
    | name      = Unknown Speaker
    | timestamp = 00:07:34.800
    | text      = They can be done.
}}

{{TranscriptBlock
    | name      = Unknown Speaker
    | timestamp = 00:07:35.800
    | text      = So I'll check that out.
}}

{{TranscriptBlock
    | name      = Unknown Speaker
    | timestamp = 00:07:37.800
    | text      = I've also been playing a little Hades too.
}}

{{TranscriptBlock
    | name      = Unknown Speaker
    | timestamp = 00:07:39.300
    | text      = Oh yeah?
}}

{{TranscriptBlock
    | name      = Unknown Speaker
    | timestamp = 00:07:39.800
    | text      = Yeah, yeah, yeah.
}}

{{TranscriptBlock
    | name      = Unknown Speaker
    | timestamp = 00:07:40.800
    | text      = I'm enjoying it.
}}

{{TranscriptBlock
    | name      = Unknown Speaker
    | timestamp = 00:07:41.800
    | text      = It's fun.
}}

{{TranscriptBlock
    | name      = Unknown Speaker
    | timestamp = 00:07:42.300
    | text      = It's good stuff.
}}

{{TranscriptBlock
    | name      = Unknown Speaker
    | timestamp = 00:07:42.800
    | text      = Mm-hmm.
}}

{{TranscriptBlock
    | name      = Unknown Speaker
    | timestamp = 00:07:43.300
    | text      = It's like Hades but it's more.
}}

{{TranscriptBlock
    | name      = Unknown Speaker
    | timestamp = 00:07:44.800
    | text      = It's almost exactly like Hades but more.
}}

{{TranscriptBlock
    | name      = Unknown Speaker
    | timestamp = 00:07:47.800
    | text      = Yeah.
}}

{{TranscriptBlock
    | name      = Unknown Speaker
    | timestamp = 00:07:48.300
    | text      = It's great.
}}

{{TranscriptBlock
    | name      = Unknown Speaker
    | timestamp = 00:07:48.800
    | text      = Nuts.
}}

{{TranscriptBlock
    | name      = Unknown Speaker
    | timestamp = 00:07:49.800
    | text      = So, Jordan, today we have an episode to go over.
}}

{{TranscriptBlock
    | name      = Unknown Speaker
    | timestamp = 00:07:51.800
    | text      = Yep.
}}

{{TranscriptBlock
    | name      = Unknown Speaker
    | timestamp = 00:07:52.300
    | text      = And we're going to talk about something.
}}

{{TranscriptBlock
    | name      = Unknown Speaker
    | timestamp = 00:07:54.800
    | text      = But first, let's take a little moment to say hello to some new wonks.
}}

{{TranscriptBlock
    | name      = Unknown Speaker
    | timestamp = 00:07:57.300
    | text      = Ooh, that's a great idea.
}}

{{TranscriptBlock
    | name      = Unknown Speaker
    | timestamp = 00:07:58.300
    | text      = So first, my partner is Alex and I'm Nick.
}}

{{TranscriptBlock
    | name      = Unknown Speaker
    | timestamp = 00:08:00.800
    | text      = Lately, we've thrown countless white supremacist quotes on each other while y'all were talking about Jones and Fuentes.
}}

{{TranscriptBlock
    | name      = Unknown Speaker
    | timestamp = 00:08:06.800
    | text      = Signed two wonks with unfortunate names.
}}

{{TranscriptBlock
    | name      = Unknown Speaker
    | timestamp = 00:08:08.800
    | text      = Thank you so much, you're now a policy wonk.
}}

{{TranscriptBlock
    | name      = Unknown Speaker
    | timestamp = 00:08:10.300
    | text      = I'm a policy wonk.
}}

{{TranscriptBlock
    | name      = Unknown Speaker
    | timestamp = 00:08:11.300
    | text      = Thank you very much.
}}

{{TranscriptBlock
    | name      = Unknown Speaker
    | timestamp = 00:08:12.300
    | text      = Thank you.
}}

{{TranscriptBlock
    | name      = Unknown Speaker
    | timestamp = 00:08:12.800
    | text      = Next, to the one and only Shub Nuggaroth the First.
}}

{{TranscriptBlock
    | name      = Unknown Speaker
    | timestamp = 00:08:16.300
    | text      = You have made us happy beyond what we thought was possible.
}}

{{TranscriptBlock
    | name      = Unknown Speaker
    | timestamp = 00:08:19.300
    | text      = You've enriched our lives so much that we cannot express it in words.
}}

{{TranscriptBlock
    | name      = Unknown Speaker
    | timestamp = 00:08:22.300
    | text      = We salute you and will forever be members of the cult of Shub Nuggaroth the First.
}}

{{TranscriptBlock
    | name      = Unknown Speaker
    | timestamp = 00:08:27.800
    | text      = We miss you, Anit, Atina, Roberto, and Dalek.
}}

{{TranscriptBlock
    | name      = Unknown Speaker
    | timestamp = 00:08:30.800
    | text      = Thank you so much, you're now a policy wonk.
}}

{{TranscriptBlock
    | name      = Unknown Speaker
    | timestamp = 00:08:32.299
    | text      = I'm a policy wonk.
}}

{{TranscriptBlock
    | name      = Unknown Speaker
    | timestamp = 00:08:33.299
    | text      = Thank you very much.
}}

{{TranscriptBlock
    | name      = Unknown Speaker
    | timestamp = 00:08:33.799
    | text      = Thank you.
}}

{{TranscriptBlock
    | name      = Unknown Speaker
    | timestamp = 00:08:34.299
    | text      = Next, Mikkel, but oh god, don't say it like it rhymes with nickel.
}}

{{TranscriptBlock
    | name      = Unknown Speaker
    | timestamp = 00:08:38.299
    | text      = It's pronounced like Michael.
}}

{{TranscriptBlock
    | name      = Unknown Speaker
    | timestamp = 00:08:39.299
    | text      = Thank you so much, you're now a policy wonk.
}}

{{TranscriptBlock
    | name      = Unknown Speaker
    | timestamp = 00:08:40.799
    | text      = I'm a policy wonk.
}}

{{TranscriptBlock
    | name      = Unknown Speaker
    | timestamp = 00:08:41.799
    | text      = Thank you very much.
}}

{{TranscriptBlock
    | name      = Unknown Speaker
    | timestamp = 00:08:42.299
    | text      = I played along with that one.
}}

{{TranscriptBlock
    | name      = Unknown Speaker
    | timestamp = 00:08:43.299
    | text      = Yep.
}}

{{TranscriptBlock
    | name      = Unknown Speaker
    | timestamp = 00:08:43.799
    | text      = And we got 10th grade in the mix, Jordan.
}}

{{TranscriptBlock
    | name      = Unknown Speaker
    | timestamp = 00:08:45.799
    | text      = Ooh.
}}

{{TranscriptBlock
    | name      = Unknown Speaker
    | timestamp = 00:08:46.299
    | text      = So thank you so much, too.
}}

{{TranscriptBlock
    | name      = Unknown Speaker
    | timestamp = 00:08:47.799
    | text      = Shoutout to DJ Dan Arkey.
}}

{{TranscriptBlock
    | name      = Unknown Speaker
    | timestamp = 00:08:49.299
    | text      = The opening still slaps on 1.5 speed.
}}

{{TranscriptBlock
    | name      = Unknown Speaker
    | timestamp = 00:08:51.799
    | text      = Big up to Dan's mom for getting him to keep the full version.
}}

{{TranscriptBlock
    | name      = Unknown Speaker
    | timestamp = 00:08:56.299
    | text      = Jordan's wife for turning him into a wife guy is my permanent bright spot.
}}

{{TranscriptBlock
    | name      = Unknown Speaker
    | timestamp = 00:08:59.799
    | text      = All meows be to Celine.
}}

{{TranscriptBlock
    | name      = Unknown Speaker
    | timestamp = 00:09:01.799
    | text      = And Jordan, can I please get a throwback?
}}

{{TranscriptBlock
    | name      = Unknown Speaker
    | timestamp = 00:09:03.799
    | text      = Hi, Carrie.
}}

{{TranscriptBlock
    | name      = Unknown Speaker
    | timestamp = 00:09:04.799
    | text      = Thank you so much, you're now a technocrat.
}}

{{TranscriptBlock
    | name      = Unknown Speaker
    | timestamp = 00:09:05.799
    | text      = Hi, Carrie.
}}

{{TranscriptBlock
    | name      = Unknown Speaker
    | timestamp = 00:09:06.799
    | text      = I'm a policy wonk.
}}

{{TranscriptBlock
    | name      = Unknown Speaker
    | timestamp = 00:09:08.299
    | text      = Four stars.
}}

{{TranscriptBlock
    | name      = Unknown Speaker
    | timestamp = 00:09:09.299
    | text      = Go home to your mother and tell her you're brilliant.
}}

{{TranscriptBlock
    | name      = Unknown Speaker
    | timestamp = 00:09:11.299
    | text      = Someone, someone sodomite sent me a bucket of poop.
}}

{{TranscriptBlock
    | name      = Unknown Speaker
    | timestamp = 00:09:13.799
    | text      = Daddy shark.
}}

{{TranscriptBlock
    | name      = Unknown Speaker
    | timestamp = 00:09:14.799
    | text      = Bomp, bomp, bomp, bomp, bomp.
}}

{{TranscriptBlock
    | name      = Unknown Speaker
    | timestamp = 00:09:16.299
    | text      = Jar Jar Binks has a Caribbean black accent.
}}

{{TranscriptBlock
    | name      = Unknown Speaker
    | timestamp = 00:09:20.299
    | text      = He's a loser little, little titty baby.
}}

{{TranscriptBlock
    | name      = Unknown Speaker
    | timestamp = 00:09:23.799
    | text      = I don't want to hate black people.
}}

{{TranscriptBlock
    | name      = Unknown Speaker
    | timestamp = 00:09:25.299
    | text      = I renounce Jesus Christ.
}}

{{TranscriptBlock
    | name      = Unknown Speaker
    | timestamp = 00:09:26.799
    | text      = Thank you so much.
}}

{{TranscriptBlock
    | name      = Unknown Speaker
    | timestamp = 00:09:27.799
    | text      = Yes, thank you very much.
}}

{{TranscriptBlock
    | name      = Unknown Speaker
    | timestamp = 00:09:29.299
    | text      = So Jordan, big news this week around InfoWars.
}}

{{TranscriptBlock
    | name      = Unknown Speaker
    | timestamp = 00:09:32.799
    | text      = Okay.
}}

{{TranscriptBlock
    | name      = Unknown Speaker
    | timestamp = 00:09:33.299
    | text      = The Supreme Court once again officially refused to hear an appeal of Alex's defamation cases
}}

{{TranscriptBlock
    | name      = Unknown Speaker
    | timestamp = 00:09:38.299
    | text      = where he lost by default judgement.
}}

{{TranscriptBlock
    | name      = Unknown Speaker
    | timestamp = 00:09:40.299
    | text      = Aww.
}}

{{TranscriptBlock
    | name      = Unknown Speaker
    | timestamp = 00:09:40.799
    | text      = In terms of the court, there are no more moves for him to make.
}}

{{TranscriptBlock
    | name      = Unknown Speaker
    | timestamp = 00:09:44.299
    | text      = And for the most part, Alex is just kind of waiting for the other shoe to fall so he can get on with it.
}}

{{TranscriptBlock
    | name      = Unknown Speaker
    | timestamp = 00:09:49.299
    | text      = In the current status quo, he has to keep InfoWars running for two reasons.
}}

{{TranscriptBlock
    | name      = Unknown Speaker
    | timestamp = 00:09:53.299
    | text      = One, if he just abandoned the company and moved on to his new fake businesses,
}}

{{TranscriptBlock
    | name      = Unknown Speaker
    | timestamp = 00:09:57.299
    | text      = it would destroy the idea that he's operating in good faith in the bankruptcy court
}}

{{TranscriptBlock
    | name      = Unknown Speaker
    | timestamp = 00:10:01.299
    | text      = and it could lead the courts to consider treating the new businesses, these fake businesses,
}}

{{TranscriptBlock
    | name      = Unknown Speaker
    | timestamp = 00:10:06.299
    | text      = as extensions of InfoWars and thus they might end up becoming subject to the bankruptcy.
}}

{{TranscriptBlock
    | name      = Unknown Speaker
    | timestamp = 00:10:11.299
    | text      = You bet.
}}

{{TranscriptBlock
    | name      = Unknown Speaker
    | timestamp = 00:10:12.299
    | text      = Two, the audience needs to see him be forced out of InfoWars,
}}

{{TranscriptBlock
    | name      = Unknown Speaker
    | timestamp = 00:10:15.799
    | text      = which is to say that he can't leave on his own.
}}

{{TranscriptBlock
    | name      = Unknown Speaker
    | timestamp = 00:10:18.299
    | text      = His entire life has been a build up to being Colonel Travis at the Alamo
}}

{{TranscriptBlock
    | name      = Unknown Speaker
    | timestamp = 00:10:22.299
    | text      = and this is basically his only shot to capture those optics.
}}

{{TranscriptBlock
    | name      = Unknown Speaker
    | timestamp = 00:10:25.299
    | text      = Alex can't afford to blow this spectacle and he knows that his audience would feel pretty let down
}}

{{TranscriptBlock
    | name      = Unknown Speaker
    | timestamp = 00:10:30.299
    | text      = if he voluntarily left the studio, so someone needs to drag him out.
}}

{{TranscriptBlock
    | name      = Unknown Speaker
    | timestamp = 00:10:34.299
    | text      = Interestingly, the worst thing that could happen to Alex right now is for this to go on longer.
}}

{{TranscriptBlock
    | name      = Unknown Speaker
    | timestamp = 00:10:40.299
    | text      = Every day he has to keep InfoWars open is a day he's losing some amount of money on the crew
}}

{{TranscriptBlock
    | name      = Unknown Speaker
    | timestamp = 00:10:45.299
    | text      = and the overhead of that dumb studio, so he has to be really hoping that people come to seize his shit soon.
}}

{{TranscriptBlock
    | name      = Unknown Speaker
    | timestamp = 00:10:51.299
    | text      = As I've said a bunch, the primary mission for Alex right now is customer migration
}}

{{TranscriptBlock
    | name      = Unknown Speaker
    | timestamp = 00:10:56.299
    | text      = and making sure that most people possible go to this new app and his new website.
}}

{{TranscriptBlock
    | name      = Unknown Speaker
    | timestamp = 00:11:01.299
    | text      = If he can get a relatively close number of customers to make that jump with him,
}}

{{TranscriptBlock
    | name      = Unknown Speaker
    | timestamp = 00:11:05.299
    | text      = he'll be able to continue doing the same kind of bullshit he's been doing,
}}

{{TranscriptBlock
    | name      = Unknown Speaker
    | timestamp = 00:11:08.299
    | text      = but with the huge expenses that InfoWars brought with it limited,
}}

{{TranscriptBlock
    | name      = Unknown Speaker
    | timestamp = 00:11:13.299
    | text      = because he'll just be doing a podcast or whatever.
}}

{{TranscriptBlock
    | name      = Unknown Speaker
    | timestamp = 00:11:15.299
    | text      = Lowering the overhead for his ridiculous business would make more sense than any other choice he could make.
}}

{{TranscriptBlock
    | name      = Unknown Speaker
    | timestamp = 00:11:20.299
    | text      = And thus, it wasn't too surprising to see that Alex was out of studio earlier this week.
}}

{{TranscriptBlock
    | name      = Unknown Speaker
    | timestamp = 00:11:25.299
    | text      = He has more important tasks than his own show right now,
}}

{{TranscriptBlock
    | name      = Unknown Speaker
    | timestamp = 00:11:28.299
    | text      = between the legal stuff and the need to drum up attention for the new site.
}}

{{TranscriptBlock
    | name      = Unknown Speaker
    | timestamp = 00:11:32.299
    | text      = As Alex has become entirely untethered to any pretense of caring about his precious constitution,
}}

{{TranscriptBlock
    | name      = Unknown Speaker
    | timestamp = 00:11:38.299
    | text      = I'm sure the audience has noticed that I've had a little bit less interest in him too.
}}

{{TranscriptBlock
    | name      = Unknown Speaker
    | timestamp = 00:11:42.299
    | text      = He's only a compelling figure so long as he's presenting a perspective that you can disagree with,
}}

{{TranscriptBlock
    | name      = Unknown Speaker
    | timestamp = 00:11:47.299
    | text      = but you have to accept is rooted in some sincere belief.
}}

{{TranscriptBlock
    | name      = Unknown Speaker
    | timestamp = 00:11:50.299
    | text      = Once that grounding is taken away, then there's no standard to judge a person by.
}}

{{TranscriptBlock
    | name      = Unknown Speaker
    | timestamp = 00:11:54.299
    | text      = Everything Alex says is a lie, not because it's all lies,
}}

{{TranscriptBlock
    | name      = Unknown Speaker
    | timestamp = 00:11:58.299
    | text      = but because if circumstances require it, anything he said can be disowned, and it doesn't matter.
}}

{{TranscriptBlock
    | name      = Unknown Speaker
    | timestamp = 00:12:03.299
    | text      = During the first Trump term, Alex probably wanted Trump to do a lot of the shit that he's doing now,
}}

{{TranscriptBlock
    | name      = Unknown Speaker
    | timestamp = 00:12:09.299
    | text      = but the difference is, he is doing it now.
}}

{{TranscriptBlock
    | name      = Unknown Speaker
    | timestamp = 00:12:13.299
    | text      = In the abstract, with someone like Alex, it's hard to take his shit talk too seriously.
}}

{{TranscriptBlock
    | name      = Unknown Speaker
    | timestamp = 00:12:17.299
    | text      = He sold shirts that said, lock her up, but you kinda got the sense that if Trump legit arrested Hillary,
}}

{{TranscriptBlock
    | name      = Unknown Speaker
    | timestamp = 00:12:23.299
    | text      = Alex might have thought that was going too far.
}}

{{TranscriptBlock
    | name      = Unknown Speaker
    | timestamp = 00:12:25.299
    | text      = January 6th is a perfect embodiment of this tension,
}}

{{TranscriptBlock
    | name      = Unknown Speaker
    | timestamp = 00:12:28.299
    | text      = where he spent months leading Stop the Steal protests and screaming about how the election was stolen,
}}

{{TranscriptBlock
    | name      = Unknown Speaker
    | timestamp = 00:12:34.299
    | text      = but when the rubber hit the road and people were storming the Capitol, he was on a bullhorn trying to stop them.
}}

{{TranscriptBlock
    | name      = Unknown Speaker
    | timestamp = 00:12:40.299
    | text      = The business always came first, and having a tyrant in office was bad for business.
}}

{{TranscriptBlock
    | name      = Unknown Speaker
    | timestamp = 00:12:45.299
    | text      = Overthrowing the 2020 election and killing Democratic senators in a riot at the Capitol,
}}
